title: Targeting and degradation of OTUB1 by Erianin for antimetastasis in esophageal squamous cell carcinoma.
authors: Zhu, Yuan; Kang, Ningning; Zhang, Li; Tao, Jianju; Xue, Wen; Li, Hui; Li, Yingcan; Zheng, Xucai; He, Wei; Ma, Junting
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药成分Erianin通过靶向OTUB1蛋白降解抑制食管鳞癌转移，属于药物-蛋白互作与肿瘤生物学，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Metastasis is a major contributor to mortality in patients with esophageal squamous cell carcinoma (ESCC); effective treatment is currently lacking. Erianin, a bioactive ingredient of traditional Chinese medicine, Dendrobium chrysotoxum, has anti-tumor activity against multiple human tumors. However, the effect and associated underlying mechanism of Erianin on ESCC antimetastasis remain unclear. PURPOSE: To investigate the anti-metastatic properties of Erianin in ESCC both in vitro and in vivo and associated molecular mechanisms. METHODS: Wound healing assay, Transwell assay, CCK-8 assay, immunohistochemistry, and lung metastasis mouse model were carried out to examine ESCC cell migration and viability in vitro and in vivo. Drug affinity responsive target stability (DARTS), cellular thermal migration assay (CETSA), molecular docking, and Surface plasmon resonance (SPR) assay were used to confirm Erianin binding to ovarian tumor ubiquitin aldehyde-binding protein 1 (OTUB1) protein. Protein stability assay, cell transfection, and western blotting were used to confirm Erianin-mediated degradation of OTUB1 and Snail via the ubiquitin-proteasome pathway. qRT-PCR and western blotting were used to assess OTUB1expression in ESCC tissues. RESULTS: Erianin suppressed the migration/invasion of ESCC cells without modulating cell viability in vitro and in vivo, bound to OTUB1 through DARTS, CETSA, and molecular docking, and SPR assay, and enhanced OTUB1 degradation via the ubiquitin-proteasome system. Moreover, Erianin inhibited the ESCC epithelial-mesenchymal transition by enhancing the ubiquitination and degradation of Snail via targeting OTUB1. CONCLUSION: Erianin inhibited ESCC metastasis through ubiquitination and degradation of Snail via targeting OTUB1. Our findings suggest Erianin as a novel OTUB1 inhibitor for preventing ESCC metastasis.
abstract_zh: 背景：转移是食管鳞状细胞癌（ESCC）患者死亡的主要原因；目前缺乏有效治疗手段。毛兰素（Erianin）是中药金钗石斛（Dendrobium chrysotoxum）中的一种生物活性成分，对多种人类肿瘤具有抗肿瘤活性。然而，毛兰素对ESCC抗转移的作用及其相关潜在机制尚不清楚。目的：探讨毛兰素在体外和体内对ESCC的抗转移特性及相关分子机制。方法：采用伤口愈合实验、Transwell实验、CCK-8实验、免疫组织化学和肺转移小鼠模型，检测ESCC细胞在体外和体内的迁移和活力。使用药物亲和响应靶标稳定性（DARTS）、细胞热迁移实验（CETSA）、分子对接和表面等离子体共振（SPR）实验，确认毛兰素与卵巢肿瘤泛素醛结合蛋白1（OTUB1）蛋白的结合。使用蛋白稳定性实验、细胞转染和蛋白质印迹法，确认毛兰素通过泛素-蛋白酶体途径介导OTUB1和Snail的降解。使用qRT-PCR和蛋白质印迹法评估ESCC组织中OTUB1的表达。结果：毛兰素抑制ESCC细胞的迁移/侵袭，而不调节体外和体内的细胞活力；通过DARTS、CETSA、分子对接和SPR实验与OTUB1结合，并通过泛素-蛋白酶体系统增强OTUB1的降解。此外，毛兰素通过靶向OTUB1增强Snail的泛素化和降解，从而抑制ESCC上皮-间质转化。结论：毛兰素通过靶向OTUB1促进Snail的泛素化和降解，从而抑制ESCC转移。我们的发现表明，毛兰素是一种新型OTUB1抑制剂，可用于预防ESCC转移。
